registered.old: A seller normally gets paid even if the buyer plans to misuse the goods, but not when the seller actively helps the misuse. A supplier that knowingly furthered the cheese maker's improper use of its product could not collect the price.
registered.new: A seller normally gets paid even if the buyer plans to misuse the goods, but not when the seller furthers the misuse. Blossom could not collect because it knew the cheese maker was mislabeling imitation cheese and kept supplying the volume orders that made it possible.
registered.reason: Blossom 'continued to supply volume shipments to Kasson, thereby engaging in a course of dealing which facilitated Kasson in its improper conduct' (C&M 751); Restatement § 182 bars a promisee who furthers the improper use, evidenced by specific acts to facilitate it. 'Actively helps' reads as more than the court required, and the sale itself was lawful.
